source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-14) and this deck's notes (deck-verify runs 38447893724 and 38447413487; Jace's starting loyalty 5 from the card). Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: Kami of the Crescent Moon
scenes.sub: Everyone draws more cards. This deck makes that hurt.

scenes.head: One trigger, every turn
scenes.sub: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card.

scenes.head: Everyone draws two
scenes.sub: Your opponents too. The trigger is symmetric, so the deck is built to use those extra cards better than they can.

scenes.head: Full hands hurt
scenes.sub: On each opponent's upkeep, [[Iron Maiden]] and [[Viseling]] deal damage equal to their cards in hand minus 4. [[Ebony Owl Netsuke]] deals 4 at seven or more.
scenes.say: Full hands hurt. On each opponent's upkeep, [[Iron Maiden]] and [[Viseling]] deal damage equal to the cards in their hand, minus four. [[Ebony Owl Netsuke]] deals four if they hold seven or more.

scenes.head: Hold the table
scenes.sub: [[Counterspell]] and [[Swan Song]] stop their best spells. [[Propaganda]] makes them pay {2} for each creature attacking you.
scenes.say: Hold the table. [[Counterspell]] and [[Swan Song]] stop their best spells. [[Propaganda]] makes them pay two mana for each creature attacking you.

scenes.head: Or empty their libraries
scenes.sub: [[Jace, Reality Sculptor]] can exile all but the bottom card of each opponent's library. Kami's extra draw does the rest.

scenes.head: Fill their hands. Hold the table. Build Jace to 25.
scenes.sub: One clip for each, then how it wins.
scenes.say: Fill their hands. Hold the table. Build Jace to twenty-five. One clip for each, then how it wins.

scenes.head: More cards for everyone
scenes.sub: [[Howling Mine]] (while untapped) and [[Dictate of Kruphix]] each give every player an additional card in their draw step. [[Temple Bell]]: tap, each player draws a card.
scenes.say: More cards for everyone. [[Howling Mine]], while it's untapped, and [[Dictate of Kruphix]] each give every player an additional card in their draw step. [[Temple Bell]]: tap it, and each player draws a card.

scenes.head: Their draw step
scenes.sub: One card for the turn, one from [[Kami of the Crescent Moon|Kami]], one from [[Howling Mine]].

scenes.head: They can't cast it all
scenes.sub: Say an opponent still holds eight cards when their next upkeep begins.

scenes.head: Their upkeep: 12 damage
scenes.sub: [[Iron Maiden]]: 8 minus 4 is 4. [[Viseling]]: 4 more. [[Ebony Owl Netsuke]]: seven or more cards, so 4 more. All before they draw.
scenes.say: Their upkeep: twelve damage. [[Iron Maiden]]: eight minus four is four. [[Viseling]]: four more. [[Ebony Owl Netsuke]]: they hold seven or more cards, so four more. All before they draw.

scenes.head: [[Black Vise]] aims at one
scenes.sub: The same math, cards in hand minus 4, against the opponent you choose as it enters.
scenes.say: [[Black Vise]] aims at one. The same math, cards in hand minus four, against the opponent you choose as it enters.

scenes.head: Every draw costs them life
scenes.sub: [[Psychosis Crawler]]: whenever you draw a card, each opponent loses 1 life. [[Scrawling Crawler]]: whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life.

scenes.head: Then cast [[Prosperity]]
scenes.sub: Both Crawlers out, X is 5: each player draws five. You draw five, so each opponent loses 5. They each draw five and lose 5 more.
scenes.say: Then cast [[Prosperity]], with both Crawlers out and X at five. Each player draws five cards. You draw five, so each opponent loses five life. They each draw five, and lose five more.

scenes.head: Ten life each, and fuller hands
scenes.sub: What they can't cast stays in hand for [[Iron Maiden]] and [[Viseling]] at their next upkeep.

scenes.head: [[Geist of Saint Thalia]]
scenes.sub: Noncreature spells you cast cost {1} less. Most of this deck is noncreature (rocks, punishers, counters), so she plays like ramp.
scenes.say: [[Geist of Saint Thalia]]. Noncreature spells you cast cost one less. Most of this deck is noncreature: mana rocks, punishers and counterspells. So she plays like ramp.

scenes.head: Turn 4, four Islands, Geist out
scenes.sub: [[Iron Maiden]] costs {2} and [[Howling Mine]] costs {1}, leaving one Island open for [[Swan Song]].
scenes.say: Turn four, four Islands, and Geist is out. [[Iron Maiden]] costs two and [[Howling Mine]] costs one, leaving one Island open for [[Swan Song]].

scenes.head: Counter what matters
scenes.sub: [[Swan Song]] and [[An Offer You Can't Refuse]] cost {U}. [[Counterspell]] counters any spell. [[Exclude]] counters a creature spell and draws a card.
scenes.say: Counter what matters. [[Swan Song]] and [[An Offer You Can't Refuse]] cost one blue mana. [[Counterspell]] counters any spell. [[Exclude]] counters a creature spell and draws you a card.

scenes.head: They cast a board wipe…
scenes.say: They cast a board wipe.

scenes.head: …[[Swan Song]] stops it
scenes.sub: Counter target enchantment, instant or sorcery spell. Its controller gets a 2/2 flying Bird.
scenes.say: [[Swan Song]] stops it. Counter target enchantment, instant or sorcery spell. Its controller gets a two-two flying Bird token.

scenes.head: Make attacking you expensive
scenes.sub: [[Propaganda]]: creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each one attacking you.
scenes.say: Make attacking you expensive. [[Propaganda]]: creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays two mana for each one attacking you.

scenes.head: When the board gets away
scenes.sub: [[Cyclonic Rift]], overloaded for {6}{U}, returns each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand. [[Aetherize]] returns all attacking creatures.
scenes.say: When the board gets away from you: [[Cyclonic Rift]], overloaded for seven mana, returns each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand. [[Aetherize]] returns all attacking creatures to their owner's hand.

scenes.head: The goal: 25 loyalty
scenes.sub: [[Jace, Reality Sculptor]]'s win needs twenty-five or more loyalty counters among Jaces you control.
scenes.say: The goal: twenty-five loyalty. [[Jace, Reality Sculptor]]'s win needs twenty-five or more loyalty counters among Jaces you control.

scenes.head: His +1: empower Jace X
scenes.sub: X is the number of Islands you control. Empower puts X loyalty counters on a Jace token you control, creating one first if you have none.
scenes.say: His plus one: empower Jace X. X is the number of Islands you control. Empower puts X loyalty counters on a Jace token you control, creating the token first if you have none.

scenes.head: Islands are the fuel
scenes.sub: Every basic [[Island]] counts. So do [[Mystic Sanctuary]] and [[Theorist's Sanctum]], which also has: {2}{U}, tap: empower Jace 2.
scenes.say: Islands are the fuel. Every basic [[Island]] counts, and so do [[Mystic Sanctuary]] and [[Theorist's Sanctum]]. You can also pay three mana, one of it blue, and tap the Sanctum to empower Jace two.

scenes.head: Before your turn 7: flash in the Proxy
scenes.sub: [[Theorist's Proxy]] has flash. When it enters, empower Jace 3: with no token yet, it creates one, then puts 3 loyalty on it.
scenes.say: Before your turn seven, at the end of an opponent's turn, flash in [[Theorist's Proxy]]. When it enters, empower Jace three. With no token yet, it creates one, then puts three loyalty on it.

scenes.head: Turn 7: make Jace uncounterable
scenes.sub: Play a seventh Island. Pay {U} and sacrifice [[Theorist's Proxy|the Proxy]]: the next spell you cast this turn can't be countered.
scenes.say: Turn seven: make Jace uncounterable. Play your seventh Island. Pay one blue mana and sacrifice [[Theorist's Proxy|the Proxy]]: the next spell you cast this turn can't be countered.

scenes.head: Cast Jace, then +1
scenes.sub: He enters with 5 loyalty. Seven Islands, so empower 7: Jace 6, token 10. Sixteen counters.
scenes.say: Cast Jace, and nobody can counter him. He enters with five loyalty. Plus one: you control seven Islands, so empower seven. Jace goes to six, the token to ten. Sixteen counters.

scenes.head: Turn 8: +1 again
scenes.sub: Eighth Island, so empower 8: Jace 7, token 18. That's 25. But Jace gets one loyalty ability per turn, so the 0 waits a turn.
scenes.say: Turn eight: plus one again. Eighth Island, so empower eight. Jace goes to seven, the token to eighteen. That's twenty-five. But Jace gets only one loyalty ability per turn, so the zero waits until next turn.

scenes.head: Under attack? Use the −3 instead
scenes.sub: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets −5/−0 until end of turn.
scenes.say: Under attack? Use Jace's minus three instead of the plus one. Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets minus five power until end of turn.

scenes.head: Turn 9: Jace's 0
scenes.sub: Twenty-five counters among your Jaces. Exile all but the bottom card of each opponent's library.
scenes.say: Turn nine: Jace's zero ability. Twenty-five counters among your Jaces. Exile all but the bottom card of each opponent's library.

scenes.head: One card left
scenes.sub: Each opponent's library is now a single card.

scenes.head: Their draw step
scenes.sub: They draw that last card. Then [[Kami of the Crescent Moon|Kami]] makes them draw an additional card, from an empty library, and a player who must draw from an empty library loses.

scenes.head: One opponent at a time
scenes.sub: Left alone, every opponent loses in their own next draw step, before they reach a main phase.

scenes.head: The other way: burn out full hands
scenes.sub: [[Iron Maiden]], [[Viseling]], [[Black Vise]] and [[Ebony Owl Netsuke]] punish full hands at upkeep. [[Psychosis Crawler]] and [[Scrawling Crawler]] punish draws.

scenes.head: Kami of the Crescent Moon
scenes.sub: Two ways to win: burn out full hands, or empty their libraries. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
